theme.recap: The best numbers come from all over basketball history. Which answer surprised you most?

questions.prompt: The chart shows points by three stars in a title-clinching Finals game. How many did Giannis Antetokounmpo score to clinch the 2021 title?
questions.note: With 14 rebounds and five blocks, to end Milwaukee's 50-year title drought.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Giannis Antetokounmpo scored a playoff career-high 50 points and added 14 rebounds and five blocks

funFacts.text: Giannis reached the championship series after hyperextending his left knee against Atlanta in the East finals.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Antetokounmpo went down in game four with a hyperextension to his left knee

funFacts.text: Milwaukee rallied from losing the first two Finals games in Phoenix to claim its long-awaited title.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Bucks won the next four games

funFacts.text: Jrue Holiday's arrival from New Orleans had bolstered the Bucks' defense before the championship run.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Bucks acquired guard Jrue Holiday, a highly respected defensive player

questions.prompt: Detroit's 2003–04 champions won 54 games. How many did the 1988–89 'Bad Boys' Pistons win?
questions.note: The league's best record, in their first season at the Palace; they then swept the Lakers for the title.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: finishing in first place in the Central Division with a league-best 63–19 record

funFacts.text: That season marked the Bad Boys' first in the brand-new Palace of Auburn Hills.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: moved from the Pontiac Silverdome to their brand-new arena known as The Palace of Auburn Hills

funFacts.text: Detroit traded Adrian Dantley to Dallas for All-Star forward Mark Aguirre.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: traded Dantley to the Dallas Mavericks in exchange for All-Star forward Mark Aguirre

funFacts.text: Detroit opened its regular season with eight straight wins.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Pistons got off to a fast start by winning their first eight games of the regular season.

questions.prompt: The chart shows three other contenders' lead playmakers. What did Jimmy Butler average in his first Heat season?
questions.note: 6.0 a game alongside 19.9 points, with 103 steals in 58 games.

funFacts.text: Butler collected 103 steals in just fifty-eight appearances.
He averaged 19.9 points while also organizing Miami's offense.
Butler started all fifty-eight regular-season games he played.

questions.prompt: Dwight Howard led the NBA with 13.8 rebounds a game in 2008–09. What did Giannis Antetokounmpo average in 2018–19, his first MVP season?
questions.context: Giannis · Milwaukee Bucks · first MVP campaign
questions.note: To go with 27.7 points and 5.9 assists, as Milwaukee finished with the East's best record.

funFacts.text: Giannis scored 27.7 points and dished out 5.9 assists per game that season.
He won his first NBA MVP award after Milwaukee led the Eastern Conference.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Giannis Antetokounmpo was named league MVP after this season

funFacts.text: Giannis and Khris Middleton represented Milwaukee in the All-Star Game.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: he and Khris Middleton were voted to play in the 2019 NBA All-Star Game

questions.prompt: In his historic 2025 triple-double against Minnesota, how many points did Nikola Jokić score despite Denver losing?
questions.context: Nikola Jokić · Nuggets vs Timberwolves · April 2025
questions.note: The highest-scoring triple-double in NBA history, in a 140–139 double-overtime loss.

funFacts.text: It was an extraordinarily high-scoring triple-double.
Harden and Luka had previously recorded 60-point triple-doubles.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: after James Harden (2018) and Luka Dončić (2022)
